column1: # What a kind is called wherever Atlas names it: what it sells, short ("Clothes", not "Clothing Store"). The owner,
# 6 November, of the shops' chips: "instead of clothing store and gift shop only show Clothes, Gifts?", then "Yes and
# apply that everywhere?". Presets.name reads it first, so the chips, the rows, a place's page and the search's
# suggestions all say it. id-tagging-schema's own name (Presets.fullName) still names a place that has no name of its
# own ("Gift Shop": a title says what the place is), and the search still knows the kind by it.
# en nl de fr  its name in each of the app's languages; - keeps id-tagging-schema's in that one
# A kind whose own name already says it in a word (Bakery, Butcher, Florist, Drugstore) or that sells no one thing (a
# department store, a convenience store, a garden center) has no line. KindNamesTest keeps the file true: every kind
# Atlas knows, every language filled, and no name that is still a shop's ("…winkel", "…geschäft", "Magasin de …").
# id-tagging-schema calls a pharmacy a "Pharmacy Counter" in English alone (Benu on the Brands board, 6 November)
